##


The Lore Behind Forsaken Roblox Characters


#


[The lore](https://forsaken2024.fandom.com/wiki/Lore) gives these **Forsaken Roblox characters** more than a set of abilities to play around with. Their relationships and backstories give fans a reason to care about what happens between matches. That is also why people look up Forsaken characters personalities and their connections when they want to write dialogue, build an OC, or figure out roleplaying settings.


###


c00lkidd x 007n7 — Found Family in a Horror Game


#


007n7 is Forsaken’s adoptive father figure: he raised c00lkidd after finding him abandoned, years before c00lkidd became an exploiter himself and one of Forsaken’s Killers. Fans lean hard into this found-family read, a Survivor and a Killer who are family first, roles second, and constantly bring this dynamic into fan art and headcanons.


###


Two Time x Azure: The Spawn Cult’s Fallout


#


Two Time’s story is closely tied to the Spawn Cult, and his respawn came from sacrificing his closest friend, Azure, for a second life. Azure didn’t stay dead, either. He later returns as a Killer after being corrupted by the Spectre. This dark edge gives **roleplay Forsaken characters** more to work with than a simple hero-versus-Killer setup. Two Time and Azure already have a relationship, a betrayal, and unresolved feelings built into their backstories.


###


Shedletsky x 1x1x1x1: A Rivalry Born From One Act


#


Shedletsky plays as a retired admin with a sword and a taste for fried chicken, but his lore has a darker edge: 1x1x1x1 is described as a physical manifestation of the hatred and negativity Shedletsky carried within himself. Shedletsky does not simply hate 1x1x1x1 in return. The character represents a part of himself he would rather reject, making their conflict more personal than a straightforward rivalry.


###


Guest 666 x Noob: A Friendship That Turned


#


Guest 666’s story also starts with a connection to Noob. Guest 666 was originally a regular Robloxian who became increasingly competitive and aggressive, while their relationship with Noob deteriorated. Later lore adds Spectre’s influence and the corruption behind Guest 666’s transformation into a Killer. It’s a smaller arc than Two Time and Azure’s, but the same shape: a friendship the game lets curdle into something else.


These relationships and each character’s archetype give the cast material that fans can take beyond the match itself: Fan art, headcanons, fan content like Forsaken oc x canon fic, all have room to build on details that the game only establishes in brief pieces.

FAQ


#


###


**Does Forsaken have a roleplay mode?**


#


Not officially. The base game is built around timed Survivor-vs-Killer matches, and threads on the Forsaken Wiki debate whether it should add one at all. That gap is exactly why so much Forsaken Roblox roleplay happens outside the game itself, through Discord servers, fan-made spinoff titles, or a dedicated Forsaken roleplay game built just for that.


###


**Why do Roblox Asym characters get so much roleplay and fan fiction?**


#


Asymmetric horror (“Asym”) games on Roblox, these Forsaken Roblox characters included, turned their casts into figures with real backstories and dedicated fandoms, not just gameplay roles. That lore is exactly why pairing these characters together, or writing forsaken x reader stories, has become such a common way for fans to spend more time with a cast the game itself moves on from.


###


**Where can I roleplay with characters like c00lkidd or Elliot outside Forsaken?**


#


A few ways: fan-made Roblox spinoffs like Forsaken Roleplay and Forsaken RP let you play as the cast outside a match, and dozens of Discord servers run dedicated Forsaken RP threads, though popular characters get claimed fast. AI-assisted character and story apps are another option, but most keep you in one chat window with one character at a time. Redbean recreates Forsaken Roblox characters like c00lkidd or Elliot as your own NPCs in your own town, so there’s no claim list and no single-character limit, just you deciding how to roleplay forsaken characters you already love.


###


**Can I ship my OC with a Forsaken character?**


#


Yes. Set up an OC and a recreated character like Azure or Two Time in the same town, define how they relate to each other, and play it out through conversation, either as a bystander directing the scene or as the OC yourself. It’s the same appeal fans already chase with oc x canon fan content, just something you can actually talk through instead of only writing.

Yes, that includes a Forsaken OC: recreate one of your own, or rebuild a canon Survivor or Killer, then talk to them, direct them, or watch them interact with the rest of your cast.
